#include <iostream>
#include <vector>
#include <set>
#include <string>

int main() {
    int a, b;
    long long l, r;
    std::cin >> a >> b >> l >> r;

    if (r - l + 1 >= 2 * (a + b)) {
        if (a <= b) {
            std::cout << a + 1 << "\n";
        } else {
            std::cout << 2 * a - b << "\n";
        }
        return 0;
    }

    std::string cString;
    for (int i = 0; i < a; i++) {
        cString += static_cast<char>('a' + i);
    }

    l--;
    r--;

    std::set<int> used;

    int ans = 26;
    for (int first = 0; first < 26; first++) {
        for (int second = a; second < 26; second++) {
            std::string tempString = cString;
            for (int i = 0; i < b; i++) {
                tempString += static_cast<char>('a' + first);
            }
            used.clear();

            // Add last a characters to used set
            for (int i = (int)tempString.size() - a; i < (int)tempString.size(); i++) {
                used.insert(tempString[i] - 'a');
            }

            int nxt = 0;
            for (int i = 0; i < a; i++) {
                while (used.count(nxt)) {
                    nxt++;
                }
                tempString += static_cast<char>('a' + nxt);
                nxt++;
            }

            for (int i = 0; i < b; i++) {
                tempString += static_cast<char>('a' + second);
            }

            int len = (int)tempString.size();

            used.clear();
            int start = l % len;
            int end = (r + 1) % len;
            int i = start;
            do {
                used.insert(tempString[i] - 'a');
                i = (i + 1) % len;
            } while (i != end);

            if ((int)used.size() < ans) {
                ans = (int)used.size();
            }
        }
    }

    std::cout << ans << "\n";

    return 0;
}
